news.title: Alphabet’s Spending Could Unlock a Massive Opportunity Investors Aren’t Pricing In
news.summary: Alphabet just burned through cash, missed on earnings, and watched its stock slide. Yet one number buried in its cloud business suggests the market is reading the selloff backward, and the answer could surprise skeptics.
news.title_zh: Alphabet的支出可能釋放投資人未計價的龐大機會
news.summary_zh: Alphabet剛燒光現金、財報不及預期、股價下滑。然而其雲端業務中隱藏的一個數字顯示，市場可能誤讀了這波拋售，答案可能會讓質疑者感到驚訝。

news.title: Not Good: Broadcom Loses $200 Billion as Chips Crash and Google Reportedly Cuts AI Chip Plans
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNot Good: Broadcom Loses $200 Billion as Chips Crash and Google Reportedly Cuts AI Chip PlansGoogle reportedly will ship more MediaTek-designed TPUs instead; neither company has confirmed it. A handful of customers drive Broadcom’s AI growth, but management says 2027 demand already exceeds its outlook.
news.title_zh: 不妙：博通失去 $200 Billion 晶片暴跌且 Google 据報削減 AI 晶片計畫
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要不妙：博通失去 $200 Billion 晶片暴跌且 Google 据報削減 AI 晶片計畫Google 据報將出貨更多聯發科設計的 TPU；雙方公司均未證實。少數客戶推動博通的 AI 成長，但管理層表示 2027 需求已超出其展望。

news.title: What's Wrong With Alphabet Stock?
news.summary: The tech stock has fallen more than 30% in just the past six months.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 股票出了什麼問題？
news.summary_zh: 這檔科技股在過去六個月內下跌超過 30%。

news.title: Alphabet Trades at “Just 18 Times Forward Earnings.” Its SpaceX and Anthropic Stakes Top $200 Billion
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphabet trades at about 19x forward earnings and passed Nvidia in market value on Friday. Its SpaceX and Anthropic stakes are worth about $230 billion, but netting them out barely moves the multiple.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 以「僅 18 Times 遠期盈餘」交易。其 SpaceX 和 Anthropic 持股超過 $200 Billion
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphabet 以約 19x 遠期盈餘交易，週五市值超越 Nvidia。其 SpaceX 和 Anthropic 持股價值約 $230 billion，但扣除後幾乎不影響倍數。

news.title: Alphabet vs. Meta Platforms: Which Media Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Alphabet's 13.9x forward P/E sits well below Meta's 20.5x, but Meta's 27.5% revenue jump makes the growth-versus-value trade-off harder to call.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 對決 Meta Platforms：哪檔媒體股是 2027 較佳買進選擇？
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 的 13.9x 遠期本益比遠低於 Meta 的 20.5x，但 Meta 的 27.5% 營收大增讓成長與價值的取捨更難判斷。

news.title: Anthropic Drove “the Entire Acceleration in AWS and Google Cloud,” per Gil Luria. That’s a Big Risk for Amazon and Alphabet
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAnthropic’s stock closed Friday 20% below its debut-day open, a hit to Amazon’s stake of about 15% and Alphabet’s 13. 7%.
news.title_zh: 據 Gil Luria 指出，Anthropic 推動了「AWS 和 Google Cloud 的全部加速」。這對 Amazon 和 Alphabet 是大風險
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Anthropic 股價週五收盤較首日開盤價低 20%，衝擊 Amazon 約 15% 的持股和 Alphabet 的 13。7%。

news.title: Billionaire Chase Coleman’s Tiger Global Cut Its Alphabet Stake by 42%
news.summary: Tiger Global dumped a huge chunk of its Alphabet shares just as Google Cloud exploded and free cash flow turned deeply negative. A 13F can't explain why, but it does expose a sizing lesson that matters more than the sale.
news.title_zh: 億萬富翁 Chase Coleman 的 Tiger Global 削減 Alphabet 持股 42%
news.summary_zh: Tiger Global 在 Google Cloud 爆發成長且自由現金流轉為深度負值時，大量拋售 Alphabet 股份。一份 13F 無法解釋原因，但確實揭露了比出售更重要的部位控管教訓。

news.title: Nvidia Must Become a Frontier Lab “Faster Than Frontier Labs Are Becoming Chip Companies.” Nemotron Is Its Head Start
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia shares are down 48% from their high after Jensen Huang’s departure as CEO and a report that the SEC is examining the company’s accounting. Nvidia’s biggest customers are building their own chips with Alphabet and Broadcom, and AI labs are moving code onto chips from AMD.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 必須成為前沿實驗室，「比前沿實驗室成為晶片公司的速度更快」。Nemotron 是其先發優勢
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Nvidia 股價較高點下跌 48%，原因是 Jensen Huang 卸任 CEO 以及有報導稱 SEC 正在調查該公司會計。Nvidia 最大客戶正與 Alphabet 和 Broadcom 自行打造晶片，AI 實驗室則將代碼遷移至 AMD 晶片上。

news.title: The App Paradigm Will “Slowly, if Not Quickly, Dissipate,” Says Mark Gurman. That’s a Problem for Apple
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBloomberg’s Mark Gurman said the app paradigm will “slowly, if not quickly, dissipate” as AI calls for a new kind of operating system. Alphabet’s Gemini sits under Apple’s rebuilt AI models, while AppLovin’s install-driven ad business needs apps to last.
news.title_zh: Mark Gurman 指出 App 範式將「緩慢地，如果不是快速地，消散」。這對 Apple 是個問題
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點彭博社的 Mark Gurman 表示，App 範式將「緩慢地，如果不是快速地，消散」，因為 AI 需要一種新型作業系統。Alphabet 的 Gemini 位於 Apple 重建的 AI 模型之下，而 AppLovin 的安裝驅動廣告業務需要 App 持續存在。

news.title: A $4.4 Billion Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysA fund with $4. 41 billion of US stocks added to Microsoft, Sandisk and Alphabet in the third quarter, its three biggest new or added positions.
news.title_zh: 一家 $4.4 Billion 基剛買入這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點一家擁有 $4。41 billion 美股的基金在第三季加碼 Microsoft、Sandisk 和 Alphabet，這是其三大新增或加碼部位。

news.title: Jason Calacanis Will “Catch Every Knife” With SpaceX, Tesla and Google. Only Some Are Cheap
news.summary: Key TakeawaysStocks had their worst week of 2026, and angel investor Jason Calacanis said he’ll put any free cash he has into SpaceX, Tesla, Uber, Shopify and Google. He says big tech trades at its lowest P/Es since the dot-com era.
news.title_zh: Jason Calacanis 將對 SpaceX、Tesla 和 Google 「接住每一把飛刀」。只有部分便宜
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點股市經歷 2026 以來最糟的一週，天使投資人 Jason Calacanis 表示將把所有閒置現金投入 SpaceX、Tesla、Uber、Shopify 和 Google。他表示大型科技股的本益比處於網際網路泡沫時期以來最低水準。

news.title: Billionaire David Tepper Just Made a Massive AI Chip Rotation — Will It Pay Off?
news.summary: Tepper was selling shares of AMD, Broadcom, and Alphabet in Q3, while buying Nvidia and Micron.
news.title_zh: 億萬富翁 David Tepper 剛進行大規模 AI 晶片輪動 —— 會有回報嗎？
news.summary_zh: Tepper 在 Q3 賣出 AMD、Broadcom 和 Alphabet 股份，同時買入 Nvidia 和 Micron。

news.summary_zh: AI投資、交易達成、創紀錄的電子遊戲銷售吸引了投資者上週的興趣。

news.title: Alibaba vs. Booking Holdings: Which E-Commerce Retail Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Alibaba and Booking are both global leaders, but their valuations, regional risks and cash flow profiles point to very different bets for 2027.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴對決Booking Holdings：哪檔電商零售股票是2027的更好買入？
news.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴和Booking都是全球領導者，但它們的估值、區域風險和現金流概況指向2027截然不同的押注。

news.title: Citi Just Cut Its Alibaba Target to $160. Could the Stock Really Climb 97%?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCiti cut its Alibaba price target to $160 from $193 on Nov. 20 and kept its Buy rating, a day after a September-quarter report in which adjusted earnings missed estimates.
news.title_zh: 花旗削減阿里巴巴目標價至$160。股票真的能漲到97%嗎？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要花旗將阿里巴巴目標價從$193下調至$160，於Nov. 20維持買入評級，這是在九月季報顯示調整後盈利未達預期的隔天。

news.title: Cathie Wood and 10 Other Big Funds Sold Alibaba Last Quarter, While 14 Bought. Who’s Right?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 14 bought Alibaba and 11 sold it, with Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest among the sellers.
news.title_zh: Cathie Wood和10其他大型基金上季賣出阿里巴巴，而14買入。誰是對的？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要在已為截至Sept. 30季度提交13F的460大型基金中，14買入阿里巴巴，11賣出，Cathie Wood的ARK Invest在賣方之列。

news.title: Alibaba Sinks 25% in a Month as Chip Curbs Threaten Its 20 GW Plan: Eddie Wu Warns of “Downward Revision”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba fell 25% in a month to a 52-week low as Washington moved to block Chinese companies from Nvidia chips rented abroad. Nvidia can’t sell its top chips in China anyway, so the curbs hurt Alibaba’s cloud far more.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴一個月下跌25%，晶片限制威脅其20 GW計劃：吳泳銘警告「下調修正」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要阿里巴巴一個月內下跌25%，跌至52週低點，因華盛頓動作阻止中國公司從國外租用輝達晶片。輝達本來就無法在中國銷售其頂級晶片，所以限制對阿里巴巴雲端業務傷害更大。

news.title: Alibaba’s AI Cloud Revenue Jumped 53%. The Problem? Free Cash Flow.
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba’s AI cloud revenue rose 53%, but adjusted earnings of 8. 10 yuan per ADS missed estimates of about 11 yuan.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴的 AI 雲端營收跳升 53%。問題？自由現金流。
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要阿里巴巴的 AI 雲端營收上升 53%，但調整後盈餘為 8。每 ADS 10 yuan 未達約 11 yuan 的預期。

news.title: Nvidia’s latest chip scandal has an Alibaba connection, new report claims
news.summary: Nvidia's sales team reportedly connected Alibaba with Alice Huang in 2022, helping establish a chip-rental business relationship that later came under scrutiny amid US investigations into suspected semiconductor smuggling.
news.title_zh: 新報告稱輝達最新晶片醜聞涉及阿里巴巴關係
news.summary_zh: 據報導，輝達銷售團隊在 2022 將阿里巴巴與 Alice Huang 牽線，促成晶片租賃業務關係，後因美國調查涉嫌半導體走私而受到審查。

news.title: A $1.5 Billion Hedge Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysHHLR Advisors, part of Hillhouse, added to PDD Holdings, Alibaba and Legend Biotech last quarter, and together they’re now just over half of its US stock portfolio. PDD and Alibaba both reported strong September quarters on Nov.
news.title_zh: 一家 $1.5 Billion 對沖基金剛買入這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要HHLR Advisors（高瓴旗下）上季加碼拼多多、阿里巴巴和Legend Biotech，三者合計現佔其美股投資組合略超過一半。拼多多和阿里巴巴皆於十一月公布強勁的九月季財報。

news.title: Alibaba Holds Its “$100 Billion in External Cloud Revenue” Goal but Warns Its 20 Gigawatt Target May Shrink
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba stuck to its goal of $100 billion in external cloud revenue in 2030, while warning that US chip curbs may force it to cut its 20-gigawatt compute target. The goal is believable, since China’s compute shortage in 2027 and 2028 should let Alibaba charge more.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴堅持其「外部雲收入 $100 Billion」目標，但警告其 20 吉瓦目標可能縮減
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點阿里巴巴堅持在 2030 達成外部雲收入 $100 billion 的目標，同時警告美國晶片限制可能迫使其削減 20 吉瓦的算力目標。這目標可信，因為中國在 2027 和 2028 的算力短缺應讓阿里巴巴能收更高費用。

news.title: Alibaba’s AI Outlook Draws Mixed Analyst Views: What Citi And Barclays Are Saying
news.summary: Barclays lowered its price target on Alibaba to $155 from $200 while maintaining an ‘Overweight’ rating, according to The Fly.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴 AI 前景引發分析師看法不一：花旗和 Barclays 的觀點
news.summary_zh: 根據 The Fly，Barclays 將阿里巴巴目標價下調至 $155 從 $200，維持「增持」評級。

news.title: Alibaba Lost Offshore AI Chip Access Days Before Earnings. Its Capex Line Shows What That Costs
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba reported on Thursday, Nov. 19, the day a US rule cutting Chinese companies off from AI chips in data centers abroad took effect, and said the rule will weigh on cloud growth next year.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴在財報前幾天失去離岸 AI 晶片存取權。其資本支出線顯示成本有多大
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點阿里巴巴於週四 Nov. 19 發布財報，當天美國切斷中國企業在海外數據中心使用 AI 晶片的規則生效，並稱該規則將拖累明年雲增長。

news.title: Could Alibaba Actually Climb 112%? Or Is Goldman Sachs Totally Wrong?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysGoldman Sachs kept its Buy rating and $177 target on Alibaba after the Nov. 19 report, 112% above that day’s close and after a 53% fall from January’s high.
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴真的能攀升至 112% 嗎？還是高盛完全錯了？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：高盛維持對阿里巴巴的買入評級及 $177 目標價，在 Nov. 19 財報後，112% 高於當日收盤價，且自一月高點以來下跌了 53%。

news.title: The Government Spends About $5.5 Billion a Day More Than It Takes In. The Debt Has Doubled in 10 Years. Jaime Dimon This the Situation Could Get Much Worse.
news.summary: Washington borrows over a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on what it already owes, and two of Wall Street's most powerful executives are warning the pressure on bond markets has not yet reached its peak.
news.title_zh: 政府每天支出比收入多約 $5.5 Billion。債務在 10 年內翻倍。Jaime Dimon 認為情況可能會惡化得更嚴重。
news.summary_zh: 華盛頓每年借入超過一兆美元僅為支付現有債務利息，華爾街兩大權勢人物警告債券市場壓力尚未達到頂峰。

news.title: Bessent Tells the Fed Not to Hike “Too Much”
news.summary: Treasury wants the Fed to ease off while the officials who actually vote on rates lean the other way. Long-bond holders sit in the middle of that standoff, and two December dates could decide who wins.
news.title_zh: Bessent 告訴聯準會不要加息「太多」
news.summary_zh: 財政部希望聯準會緩手，而實際投票決定利率的官員則傾向相反方向。長期債券持有者處於這場對峙的中間，而十二月的兩個日期可能決定誰獲勝。

news.title: Kevin Warsh’s Fed Will Vote on Rates Only 7 Times in 2027
news.summary: The Fed is quietly trimming its meeting calendar, and long-term Treasuries already flinched. With a hike looming in December, fewer decision days could make every surprise hit bond holders harder. Which corner of the bond market gets hurt most?
news.title_zh: Kevin Warsh 的聯準會將僅在 2027 對利率投票 7 Times 次
news.summary_zh: 聯準會正悄悄縮減其會議行程，長期公債已有所反應。隨著十二月即將加息，較少的決策日可能使每個驚喜對債券持有者的衝擊更大。債券市場的哪個角落受損最重？

news.title: The U.S. Just Ran Its Biggest October Deficit Ever: $404 Billion
news.summary: A record October gap has a calendar quirk hiding the real story, and bond investors are already reacting. Why do long-dated Treasury funds feel the pain first, and what would prove the bearish case wrong by December?
news.title_zh: 美國剛錄得有史以來最大的十月赤字：$404 Billion
news.summary_zh: 創紀錄的十月缺口因行曆怪癖而掩蓋了真實故事，債券投資者已有反應。為何長期公債基金首當其衝感受痛苦，到十二月什麼情況能證明看空論點錯誤？

news.title: Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDA. Why Apple, Broadcom, and Anthropic Could Be Under Pressure
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return as CEO of NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) sent stocks sharply higher on Monday morning. NVIDIA shares opened up 34% at about $170, restoring more than $1 trillion of value to shareholders. The NASDAQ rose about 6.75% and the S&P 500 about 4.6%, erasing much of Friday's sell-off. Bleeker focuses on stocks lagging a market where nearly everything is up. Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) gained only about 1.7%, and he says a rotation back into AI-adjacent names could pull capital out of the safe-haven stock. Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) rose about 6% at the open, trailing the NASDAQ and semiconductor indexes. It fell about 12% Friday on reports that Google was cutting some of its TPU allocation. Anthropic (NASDAQ: ANT) also rose 6%, but its shares have been under pressure since Thursday's IPO, and NVIDIA's backing of open-weight models is a competitive threat. CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) fell about 5% at the open, partly on its $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS). Bleeker notes that money that moved into cybersecurity as semiconductors sold off could rotate back. He says to watch for competitive pressure on these names in the coming weeks.
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳重返 NVIDIA。為何蘋果、博通和 Anthropic 可能面臨壓力
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 指出，黃仁勳以 NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) 執行長身分回歸，讓股價週一早盤大幅上漲。NVIDIA 股價開盤上漲 34% 至約 $170，為股東恢復逾 $1 trillion 價值。納斯達克上漲約 6.75%，標普 500 上漲約 4.6%，抹平週五大部分跌幅。Bleeker 關注在幾乎全盤上漲的市場中落後的股票。蘋果 (NASDAQ: AAPL) 僅上漲約 1.7%，他表示資金輪回至 AI 相關股票可能會從避風港股票抽離資金。博通 (NASDAQ: AVGO) 開盤上漲約 6%，落後於納斯達克和半導體指數。週五因傳聞谷歌削減部分 TPU 配置而下跌約 12%。Anthropic (NASDAQ: ANT) 也上漲 6%，但其股價自週四 IPO 以來承壓，且 NVIDIA 支持開放權重模型構成競爭威脅。CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) 開盤下跌約 5%，部分原因是其 $44 billion 收購 Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS)。Bleeker 指出，隨著半導體遭拋售而流入網安的資金可能輪回。他建議未來幾週關注這些股票的競爭壓力。

news.title: AMD’s Valuation is Getting Ahead of Its Fundamentals
news.summary: AMD has been the darling of large-cap semiconductor investors this year, with its stock up 98% so far even after Friday’s big selloff. While some on Wall Street think the recent turmoil at Nvidia could be an opportunity for AMD to sell more of its AI chips to customers and steal market share, its valuation is already predicated on sky-high growth expectations and doesn’t reflect the geopolitical, financing and execution risks the company faces. AMD, whose chips many customers regard as cheaper, second-rate alternatives to Nvidia’s, began trading at a valuation premium to Nvidia and rival chip designer Broadcom in the second half of last year. That’s when AMD announced that it had signed a deal to give OpenAI the right to buy a substantial chunk of its shares in exchange for purchasing 6 gigawatts worth of its AI chips. AMD signed a similar deal with Meta Platforms in February this year, which has helped boost its growth projections.
news.title_zh: AMD 估值超越其基本面
news.summary_zh: AMD 今年一直是大型半導體投資者的寵兒，其股價迄今上漲 98%，即使在週五大幅拋售後也是如此。雖然華爾街一些人認為 Nvidia 近期的動盪可能是 AMD 向客戶銷售更多 AI 晶片並搶佔市場份額的機會，但其估值已建立在極高的成長預期之上，並未反映公司面臨的地緣政治、融資和執行風險。AMD 的晶片被許多客戶視為比 Nvidia 更便宜、次等的替代品，去年下半年開始以高於 Nvidia 和競爭對手晶片設計商 Broadcom 的估值溢價交易。那是 AMD 宣布與 OpenAI 簽署協議，給予其購買大量股份的權利，以換取購買 6 吉瓦特價值的 AI 晶片時。AMD 在今年二月與 Meta Platforms 簽署了類似協議，這有助於提升其成長預測。

news.title: Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDA. Why Apple, Broadcom, and Anthropic Could Be Under Pressure
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return as CEO of NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) sent stocks sharply higher on Monday morning. NVIDIA shares opened up 34% at about $170, restoring more than $1 trillion of value to shareholders. The NASDAQ rose about 6.75% and the S&P 500 about 4.6%, erasing much of Friday's sell-off. Bleeker focuses on stocks lagging a market where nearly everything is up. Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) gained only about 1.7%, and he says a rotation back into AI-adjacent names could pull capital out of the safe-haven stock. Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) rose about 6% at the open, trailing the NASDAQ and semiconductor indexes. It fell about 12% Friday on reports that Google was cutting some of its TPU allocation. Anthropic (NASDAQ: ANT) also rose 6%, but its shares have been under pressure since Thursday's IPO, and NVIDIA's backing of open-weight models is a competitive threat. CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) fell about 5% at the open, partly on its $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS). Bleeker notes that money that moved into cybersecurity as semiconductors sold off could rotate back. He says to watch for competitive pressure on these names in the coming weeks.
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳重返 NVIDIA。為何蘋果、博通和 Anthropic 可能面臨壓力
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 指出，黃仁勳以 NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) 執行長身分回歸，讓股價週一早盤大幅上漲。NVIDIA 股價開盤上漲 34% 至約 $170，為股東恢復逾 $1 trillion 價值。納斯達克上漲約 6.75%，標普 500 上漲約 4.6%，抹平週五大部分跌幅。Bleeker 關注在幾乎全盤上漲的市場中落後的股票。蘋果 (NASDAQ: AAPL) 僅上漲約 1.7%，他表示資金輪回至 AI 相關股票可能會從避風港股票抽離資金。博通 (NASDAQ: AVGO) 開盤上漲約 6%，落後於納斯達克和半導體指數。週五因傳聞谷歌削減部分 TPU 配置而下跌約 12%。Anthropic (NASDAQ: ANT) 也上漲 6%，但其股價自週四 IPO 以來承壓，且 NVIDIA 支持開放權重模型構成競爭威脅。CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) 開盤下跌約 5%，部分原因是其 $44 billion 收購 Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS)。Bleeker 指出，隨著半導體遭拋售而流入網安的資金可能輪回。他建議未來幾週關注這些股票的競爭壓力。

news.title: AMD’s Valuation is Getting Ahead of Its Fundamentals
news.summary: AMD has been the darling of large-cap semiconductor investors this year, with its stock up 98% so far even after Friday’s big selloff. While some on Wall Street think the recent turmoil at Nvidia could be an opportunity for AMD to sell more of its AI chips to customers and steal market share, its valuation is already predicated on sky-high growth expectations and doesn’t reflect the geopolitical, financing and execution risks the company faces. AMD, whose chips many customers regard as cheaper, second-rate alternatives to Nvidia’s, began trading at a valuation premium to Nvidia and rival chip designer Broadcom in the second half of last year. That’s when AMD announced that it had signed a deal to give OpenAI the right to buy a substantial chunk of its shares in exchange for purchasing 6 gigawatts worth of its AI chips. AMD signed a similar deal with Meta Platforms in February this year, which has helped boost its growth projections.
news.title_zh: AMD 估值超越其基本面
news.summary_zh: AMD 今年一直是大型半導體投資者的寵兒，其股價迄今上漲 98%，即使在週五大幅拋售後也是如此。雖然華爾街一些人認為 Nvidia 近期的動盪可能是 AMD 向客戶銷售更多 AI 晶片並搶佔市場份額的機會，但其估值已建立在極高的成長預期之上，並未反映公司面臨的地緣政治、融資和執行風險。AMD 的晶片被許多客戶視為比 Nvidia 更便宜、次等的替代品，去年下半年開始以高於 Nvidia 和競爭對手晶片設計商 Broadcom 的估值溢價交易。那是 AMD 宣布與 OpenAI 簽署協議，給予其購買大量股份的權利，以換取購買 6 吉瓦特價值的 AI 晶片時。AMD 在今年二月與 Meta Platforms 簽署了類似協議，這有助於提升其成長預測。

news.title: NuScale Is Down 40% in a Month and Just Hit a New 52-Week Low. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNuScale shares are down 40% in the past month to a new 52-week low, falling further than Oklo as AI-power and nuclear stocks sold off after the election. The third quarter didn’t break the business: NuScale has $1.

news.title: NuScale Sinks 22% in a Week to a 52-Week Low as Canada’s First SMR Runs Late. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNuScale fell 22% in a week to a 52-week low after Canada’s first GE Vernova Hitachi small modular reactor ran late and over budget. Oklo fell too, but NuScale, still without a binding module order, fell about twice as much.
news.title_zh: NuScale 下跌 22% 於一週內至 52 週低點，因加拿大首座 SMR 延遲。賣壓是否過度？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要NuScale 一週內下跌 22%，跌至 52 週低點，因加拿大首座 GE Vernova Hitachi 小型模組化反應爐延遲且超支。Oklo 也下跌，但 NuScale 仍無具約束力的模組訂單，跌幅約為其兩倍。

news.title: Oklo Sits Near Its 52-Week Low After a 5-Reactor Fuel Deal. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?

news.title_zh: Oklo 處於其 52 週低點附近，在 5 反應爐燃料交易後。是賣出還是加碼時機？

news.summary: An overnight bounce in stocks erupted into a surge after Nvidia Corp.’s reinstatement of Jensen Huang as chief executive officer recharged artificial-intelligence bets. news.title: Warning for CoreWeave: Satya Nadella Says “Selling to One or Two Customers Is Not a Business”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft CEO Satya Nadella said selling to one or two customers “is not a business,” and that Microsoft builds its own capacity first and rents last. That’s a warning for CoreWeave, whose three biggest customers made up 72% of second-quarter revenue, and for Nebius and IREN, which count Microsoft as an anchor customer.
news.title_zh: 對 CoreWeave 的警告：Satya Nadella 說「只賣給一兩個客戶不是生意」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella 表示，只賣給一兩個客戶「不是生意」，且 Microsoft 先建設自有產能、最後才出租。這對 CoreWeave 是個警告，其前三大客戶佔第二季營收的 72%，對於以 Microsoft 為錨定客戶的 Nebius 和 IREN 也是如此。

news.title: Riot Platforms Just Gained 18% in a Month on a $28 Billion AI Lease. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysRiot Platforms rose 18% in a month on a $28 billion lease to Anthropic. Riot’s tenant buys the computers, so unlike IREN, Riot builds at about half the usual cost and doesn’t currently expect to sell stock.
news.title_zh: Riot Platforms 一月漲幅 18%，憑藉 $28 Billion AI 租約。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Riot Platforms 一個月上漲 18%，憑藉 $28 billion 租約給 Anthropic。Riot 的租戶購買電腦，所以不同於 IREN，Riot 建設成本約為一般的一半，且目前不預期出售股票。

news.title: Between IREN and CoreWeave Here’s Who Has the Cleaner Path to a Sustained 30% Rebound
news.summary: Both AI cloud darlings tumbled after NVIDIA flashed a warning on financing, yet one sits on billions in customer prepayments while the other still hunts a $6B funding gap. Which stock can actually power a lasting comeback?
news.title_zh: 在 IREN 和 CoreWeave 之間，誰擁有更清晰的路徑實現持續的 30% 反彈
news.summary_zh: 在 NVIDIA 發出融資警告後，兩家 AI 雲端寵兒股價雙雙暴跌，但一家擁有數十億美元客戶預付款，另一家仍在尋覓 $6B 資金缺口。哪檔股票真能推動持久反彈？

news.title: Cipher Digital Sinks 5%, CoreWeave Down 7% as Anthropic’s Debut Fails to Stop AI Selloff
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCipher Digital fell 5% this morning with no company news, as the AI selloff outlasted Anthropic’s record Nasdaq debut. CoreWeave and IREN fell too, as the market sells AI data center stocks as one group.
news.title_zh: Cipher Digital 下跌 5%，CoreWeave 下跌 7%，因 Anthropic 首秀無法阻止 AI 拋售潮
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Cipher Digital 早盤下跌 5%，且無公司消息，因 AI 拋售潮持續時間超過 Anthropic 破紀錄的納斯達克首秀。CoreWeave 和 IREN 也下跌，因市場將 AI 資料中心股票作為一組進行拋售。

news.title: Nebius Drops 7% as Michael Burry Takes a Victory Lap on Neocloud Rout; IREN Falls 5%, Oracle Slides 4%
news.summary: Michael Burry says he warned everyone, and the neocloud rout is giving him plenty of ammunition. But one hedge fund manager spots a demand signal buried in Anthropic's IPO filing that the bears may be missing.
